assertion_analysis.fails_if: A patched scan/read_review binding was not found; positive instrumentation checks, not product regression coverage.
The ticker omits or substitutes a run, or the fixture stops representing forty live pointers; events come from runtime and paths from the independently seeded fixture.
The producer fails to complete a second tick and invoke the injected sleeper with the expected sentinel.
Restoring per-run store listings makes enumerations exceed one, or repeated/missing first-tick reviews change independently counted call totals.
An unchanged second tick performs any review read or extra listing; base already satisfies the zero-read portion but fails the one-listing portion.
The rewrite control replaces the inode or changes directory identity; these check that the test exercises in-place invalidation.
Restoring the old per-run listing path makes first-tick enumerations exceed one.
An in-place rewrite is missed, or restoring shared-directory invalidation rereads unrelated runs on atomic replacement.
Record bytes remain stale after rewrite even if lookup is called; returned values are compared with fixed expected scores from independent on-disk edits, not with an input passed to the lookup.

evidence_caveats: The base negative control already reports no second-tick read_review calls; it fails the opening-tick enumeration assertion (101 versus 1), not the unchanged-read assertion. Preserve this observed correction rather than asserting the live plan's unsupported expected base read count.
Gate logs measure code revision a43d8ca6fca20352b58243b0d2965b1ac816b66b; the reviewed final commit changes only evidence HTML.
No product code or tests were modified or rerun by this review; review worktree HEAD is db774d6c1ede7a4cbb5f3675578bcc0e7032501d and source was read with git show at the reviewed head.

findings.text: blocking: The live section requires a bound on per-run stat calls through every binding, but the fixture instruments only scandir and read_review; restoring repeated Path.stat or os.stat calls inside the review lookup would leave every added assertion green.

blocking: None of the three regression cases rewrites a reviewed run's manifest or its named gate logs; the live section requires these annotation inputs to invalidate the answer, and a stale added-failure annotation can therefore pass this gate.
